id: title:fasyy612:clamp down to 15000 mutations in second

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop recording playback stability and recovery from DOM-heavy recordings
review.reason: The change replaces a simple event-count threshold with a time-windowed sliding window check for oversized DOM mutations, allowing the system to distinguish between many small events and a burst of mutations that could freeze playback. P1.F2.H2 implements this new detection and its configurable parameters, while P1.F3.H1 adds a guard to skip player initialization if oversized, unsk
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and recovery effectiveness are not demonstrated; this is a defensive implementation. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
